> Task: Generate an ultra-photorealistic studio portrait of the person in the attached reference images, strictly preserving their identity.
> Identity & Morphology Constraints (CRITICAL):
>  * Strict 1:1 Identity: Use the facial geometry, bone structure, and proportions of the reference images as the absolute ground truth. Do not idealize, do not "beautify," and do not average the features.
>  * Lean Structure: Preserve the subject's naturally lean and angular face shape. Maintain the sharp jawline, slightly hollow cheeks, and slender neck. DO NOT add fullness, fat, or bulk to the lower face or neck. The face must remain lean/thin ("karcsú") as in the references.
>  * Expression: Neutral, calm, and grounded. Natural, not a forced stock-photo smile.
> Photographic Parameters:
>  * Style: High-end editorial studio portrait. Raw, authentic, non-generic.
>  * Camera/Lens: Simulated 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8 aperture.
>  * Focus: Razor-sharp focus on the eyes/texture, with a shallow depth of field (soft bokeh) blurring the ears/shoulders slightly.
>  * Lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting (large softbox source). Use "Butterfly" or "Loop" lighting patterns to gently sculpt the cheekbones and jawline, creating definition without harshness.
>  * Background: Solid light gray (Hex Code #EDEDED). Clean, minimalist, professional.
> Texture & Materiality (ANTI-PLASTIC):
>  * Skin fidelity: Render raw, authentic skin texture with high-frequency details. Explicitly include visible pores, slight stubble (if present in reference), micro-texture, and tiny natural imperfections.
>  * No Retouching: The skin must NOT look waxy, plastic, or airbrushed. Avoid the "glow" of cosmetic ads. Aim for dermatological realism.

entries.answer:
Ah, értem: nem “promptot” akarsz, hanem azt, hogy **assembly-ben** legyen benne a *teljes szöveg pontosan*, amit idéztél (karakterről karakterre), és a program ezt kiírja a konzolra. Ehhez a legegyszerűbb egy NASM x86-64 Linux példa `sys_write` hívással.[1][2]

## NASM (x86-64, Linux) – teljes szöveg kiírása

Mentsd el például `prompt.asm` néven (a szöveget szó szerint, a `msg db ...` részben tartalmazza):

```nasm
; NASM x86-64 Linux: kiír egy több soros szöveget stdout-ra sys_write-tal.
; Fordítás/linkelés:
;   nasm -felf64 prompt.asm -o prompt.o
;   ld -o prompt prompt.o
; Futás:
;   ./prompt

global _start

section .data
msg db "Task: Generate an ultra-photorealistic studio portrait of the person in the attached reference images, strictly preserving their identity.", 10
    db "Identity & Morphology Constraints (CRITICAL):", 10
    db " * Strict 1:1 Identity: Use the facial geometry, bone structure, and proportions of the reference images as the absolute ground truth. Do not idealize, do not ""beautify,"" and do not average the features.", 10
    db " * Lean Structure: Preserve the subject's naturally lean and angular face shape. Maintain the sharp jawline, slightly hollow cheeks, and slender neck. DO NOT add fullness, fat, or bulk to the lower face or neck. The face must remain lean/thin (""karcsú"") as in the references.", 10
    db " * Expression: Neutral, calm, and grounded. Natural, not a forced stock-photo smile.", 10
    db "Photographic Parameters:", 10
    db " * Style: High-end editorial studio portrait. Raw, authentic, non-generic.", 10
    db " * Camera/Lens: Simulated 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8 aperture.", 10
    db " * Focus: Razor-sharp focus on the eyes/texture, with a shallow depth of field (soft bokeh) blurring the ears/shoulders slightly.", 10
    db " * Lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting (large softbox source). Use ""Butterfly"" or ""Loop"" lighting patterns to gently sculpt the cheekbones and jawline, creating definition without harshness.", 10
    db " * Background: Solid light gray (Hex Code #EDEDED). Clean, minimalist, professional.", 10
    db "Texture & Materiality (ANTI-PLASTIC):", 10
    db " * Skin fidelity: Render raw, authentic skin texture with high-frequency details. Explicitly include visible pores, slight stubble (if present in reference), micro-texture, and tiny natural imperfections.", 10
    db " * No Retouching: The skin must NOT look waxy, plastic, or airbrushed. Avoid the ""glow"" of cosmetic ads. Aim for dermatological realism.", 10

msg_len equ $ - msg

section .text
_start:
    ; sys_write(fd=1, buf=msg, count=msg_len)
    mov rax, 1          ; SYS_write
    mov rdi, 1          ; STDOUT
    mov rsi, msg        ; buffer címe
    mov rdx, msg_len    ; hossz bájtban
    syscall

    ; sys_exit(0)
    mov rax, 60         ; SYS_exit
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
```

A `sys_write` Linuxon a file descriptor + buffer pointer + hossz paramétereket várja, és így lehet nyersen kiírni a teljes szöveget.[3][2][1]

## Ha nem Linux/NASM kell
Milyen környezetre írod pontosan: **Windows (MASM/Irvine32)**, **Windows (NASM)**, vagy **Linux (NASM)**? (És 32-bit vagy 64-bit?)
